title: Dedication Offerings

questions.question: Who brought offerings on the day Moses finished setting up the tabernacle?
options: The chiefs of Israel, heads of fathers' houses
questions.correctAnswer: The chiefs of Israel, heads of fathers' houses
questions.explanation: Numbers 7:2 (ESV): "Then the chiefs of Israel, heads of their fathers' houses... offered."

questions.question: How many covered wagons and oxen were brought?
questions.explanation: Numbers 7:3 (ESV): "Six covered wagons and twelve oxen..."

questions.question: Who received NO wagons or oxen?
questions.explanation: Numbers 7:9 (ESV): "But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because they were charged with the service of the holy things that had to be carried on the shoulder."

questions.question: How long did the leaders present their offerings?
questions.explanation: Numbers 7:11 (ESV): "One chief on one day, and another chief on another day..." (for 12 tribes).

questions.question: Who offered on the first day?
questions.explanation: Numbers 7:12 (ESV): "He who offered his offering on the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah."

questions.question: What metal were the dishes and basins made of?
questions.explanation: Numbers 7:13 (ESV): "One silver plate... one silver basin..."

questions.question: What was the weight of the silver plate?
questions.explanation: Numbers 7:13 (ESV): "One silver plate whose weight was 130 shekels..."

questions.question: What was in the golden dish?
questions.explanation: Numbers 7:14 (ESV): "One golden dish of ten shekels, full of incense."

questions.question: What animals were offered for the peace offerings by each chief?
options: Two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs
questions.correctAnswer: Two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs
questions.explanation: Numbers 7:17 (ESV): "And for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs..."

questions.question: Where did Moses hear the voice of God speaking to him?
options: From above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the testimony
questions.correctAnswer: From above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the testimony
questions.explanation: Numbers 7:89 (ESV): "He heard the voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat... from between the two cherubim."

questions.question: What was the total weight of the silver vessels?
questions.explanation: Numbers 7:85 (ESV): "So that all the silver of the vessels was 2,400 shekels."

questions.question: Who offered on the seventh day?
questions.explanation: Numbers 7:48 (ESV): "On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, the chief of the people of Ephraim."

questions.question: Who offered on the twelfth day?
questions.explanation: Numbers 7:78 (ESV): "On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, the chief of the people of Naphtali."

questions.question: What was the total number of gold dishes?
From where did the voice speak to Moses?
questions.explanation: Numbers 7:89 (ESV): "From between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him."

key_verse_text: And when Moses went into the tent of meeting to speak with the Lord, he heard the voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the testimony, not between the two cherubim.
